status: written BEFORE any scoring is wired, which is the only time it is cheap
why_this_exists: P2 re-tested its own statistics and found two defects that INFLATE significance, plus a third that invalidated the mechanism behind this arm's final-shard reservation. Its point estimates reproduced to within 0.0001 -- the uncertainty was wrong, not the measurement. All three are substrate-independent, so they land here whether or not they bit the bacterial arm. Written before the scorer exists because the alternative is retracting twice.

1_the_final_shard_reservation_rested_on_.what_it_claimed_verbatim: Repeated interrogation of a single frozen scoring split overfits invisibly -- each decision taken after looking at it tunes to it, without any step that looks like fitting.
1_the_final_shard_reservation_rested_on_.why_that_is_wrong: The shared-split offset does NOT grow with the number of looks, and it CANCELS in a candidate-versus-candidate difference. What grows is SELECTION, and the multiplier is M = the number of candidates the split's feedback INFORMED -- not the number of times the split was read.
consequences_and_they_cut_BOTH_WAYS: A PRE-SPECIFIED grid is largely exempt. The oracle gate was declared in its own script before it ran, so reading folds 9-10 for it contributes ~nothing. Under the retracted mechanism it was counted as one of two spent queries; it should not have been.

ADAPTIVE follow-ons are what is exposed, and this arm has exactly one: the verdict threshold was changed from absolute to ceiling-relative AFTER seeing folds 9-10, using a ceiling derived FROM folds 9-10. Under the retracted mechanism that was one query among two. Under the corrected one it is the single real exposure, and it is worse than a query -- the verdict RULE itself was informed by the held-out data.
So the corrected accounting is SHARPER on the item that matters and more forgiving on the item that was being counted. It is not a wash and must not be reported as one.
1_the_final_shard_reservation_rested_on_.what_actually_fixes_it: Not 'query fold 10 exactly once' -- a query cap does not address selection at all. Re-derive the ceiling on fold 9 ALONE, and keep every parameter of the ceiling-relative rule off fold 10. That is already this arm's outstanding M4 item; the corrected mechanism makes it the load-bearing one rather than a tidy-up.
1_the_final_shard_reservation_rested_on_.the_reservation_still_stands_as_an_ACTIO: Reserving fold 10 remains sound as prudence, and costs only discipline here. It simply must not be described as the thing that prevents overfitting, and it must not drive design.

2_a_design_choice_this_correction_INVERT.choice: scripts/server1/glm_human_diffusion_server1.py fixes the eval split seed at 12345 across every run, so every run shares one validation slice.
2_a_design_choice_this_correction_INVERT.under_the_retracted_mechanism: a liability -- one split read over and over was the thing said to overfit invisibly.
2_a_design_choice_this_correction_INVERT.under_the_corrected_mechanism: an ASSET. A shared split makes the offset common to every candidate, so it cancels in the candidate-versus-candidate differences this arm actually reports. Recorded because the instinct under the old story would have been to randomise it per run, which would have ADDED variance to every contrast for no benefit.

RULE_1_THE_UNIT_OF_REPLICATION.peer_finding: P2 pooled 20 generation seeds x 2 scoring-split seeds as 40 independent replicates. The two split seeds RE-SCORE THE SAME generated set, so the generated set is the unit and there were 20. That understates the sem by up to sqrt(2), in the direction that manufactures significance.
RULE_1_THE_UNIT_OF_REPLICATION.does_it_bite_this_arm_as_stated: Not yet -- no scoring is wired, and nothing here re-scores one generated set under several splits.
RULE_1_THE_UNIT_OF_REPLICATION.but_the_SAME_ERROR_ONE_LEVEL_UP_was_abou: This arm's own planned refinement was 'sampling costs seconds against hours of training, so emit several sampling seeds per trained model and gain replicates for free'. Those sampling seeds produce genuinely DIFFERENT generated sets, so they are not literally P2's defect -- but they share one trained model, so they are not independent replicates of the generator either. Counting them as such is P2's error at the next level of nesting, and potentially a far larger understatement than sqrt(2).
the_nesting_is_THREE_deep: level 1 -- scoring split: re-scoring one generated set under k splits gives ZERO additional replicates (P2's case).
level 2 -- generated set: one trained model sampled under k sampling seeds gives k generated sets. Legitimate replicates for a claim about THAT TRAINED MODEL.
level 3 -- trained run: k training seeds give k trained runs. The only legitimate replicates for a claim about an ARCHITECTURE or a SIZE.
RULE_1_THE_UNIT_OF_REPLICATION.the_rule: Count replicates at the level of the thing the claim is about, and average the inner levels WITHIN each outer unit before computing any spread you intend to test with. A design-to-spec verdict is a claim about the generator, so the unit is the TRAINED RUN.

which_variance_gates_the_verdict.the_bar_is_genuinely_AMBIGUOUS_here: The frozen bar says the tolerance is 'the generated set's own seed spread, derived in the run'. Read literally that is level 2, sampling variance. The quantity a size or architecture verdict needs is level 3.
which_variance_gates_the_verdict.resolved: Use the ACROSS-TRAINED-RUN spread (level 3) as the tolerance that gates the verdict, and report the within-run sampling spread (level 2) beside it.
which_variance_gates_the_verdict.why_this_direction_and_not_the_literal_r: Level 3 is the OUTER and therefore larger variance. Choosing the inner one would be the significance-manufacturing direction -- the same error as P2's, just with a bigger multiplier. A frozen bar is not edited to resolve its own ambiguity; the conservative reading is taken and recorded.
which_variance_gates_the_verdict.cost_recorded_honestly: This makes the tolerance harder to clear, so a true effect is more likely to be called unresolved. That is the correct trade when the alternative is reporting a spread that understates itself.

RULE_2_CORRECT_FOR_SELECTING_FROM_A_FAMI.peer_finding: Reporting whichever candidate cleared a per-candidate 95% CI among N examined prices nothing. A sign-flip permutation over WHOLE replicate rows keeps every candidate's value for that row together, so the cross-candidate correlation is carried into the null instead of assumed away, and yields one family-wise p with no independence assumption. Applied to P2's own numbers, 0 of 6 leakage estimates and 0 of 10 unit-vs-unit pairs survived.

where_it_applies_HERE_and_where_it_does_.EXEMPT_the_primary_verdict: The bar pre-specifies one comparison per cell -- target monotonicity, then top-target lift against the activity-stratified null's lift. M = 1. Per RULE_1's corrected selection mechanism a pre-specified comparison is largely exempt, so no family-wise correction is owed and applying one would be a self-inflicted power loss.
where_it_applies_HERE_and_where_it_does_.EXEMPT_the_two_cells: The bar forbids pooling HepG2 and K562 and requires every quantity per cell. Two pre-specified per-cell reports are not a family of candidates one winner is picked from. No correction; but equally, a result in one cell may NOT be presented as replicated by the other.
where_it_applies_HERE_and_where_it_does_.EXPOSED_the_model_size_curve: Four sizes (s/m/l/xl). Any reading of the form 'the curve turns over at xl' or 'size l is the sized-to-data point and it clears' SELECTS from a family of four informed by the same data. This needs the sign-flip permutation over whole replicate rows and ONE family-wise p.
where_it_applies_HERE_and_where_it_does_.EXPOSED_any_adaptive_follow_on: Anything added after seeing a number -- an extra size, a changed step budget, a new threshold. Each such addition increments M and must be declared when it happens, not reconstructed afterwards.

RULE_2_CORRECT_FOR_SELECTING_FROM_A_FAMI.implementation: Permute SIGNS over whole replicate rows (a row = one trained run's vector of per-size values), not over individual cells. Flipping a whole row preserves the within-row correlation across sizes, which is exactly the structure a per-candidate CI throws away.

RULE_3_PRECONDITIONS_THAT_RAISE.peer_finding: P2's heldout_auroc returned None on ImportError through the SAME channel as a legitimate 'too small to split', so an interpreter without sklearn produced zero replicates indistinguishable from zero scoreable replicates. None of its four controls catches this: a floor that never computes is not a failing floor, it is no floor. It is a PRECONDITION, not a fifth control, and it must raise rather than return an ignorable verdict.
RULE_3_PRECONDITIONS_THAT_RAISE.the_specific_channel_is_ABSENT_here_and_: This arm's scoring path has a hand-written spearman and a hand-written ridge in scripts/glm_human_activity_oracle.py and imports neither sklearn nor scipy nor numpy. So P2's exact ImportError channel cannot occur. Checked rather than assumed.

but_the_SAME_SHAPE_was_present_and_WORSE.found: scripts/glm_human_activity_oracle.py, the zero-variance guard in spearman
but_the_SAME_SHAPE_was_present_and_WORSE.old_behaviour: returned 0.0 when either side had zero rank variance
but_the_SAME_SHAPE_was_present_and_WORSE.why_worse_than_the_sklearn_case: 0.0 is a perfectly ordinary Spearman value, whereas P2's None at least looked unusual. THREE distinct conditions arrived as one indistinguishable measurement: constant predictions (a dead conditioning knob), constant targets (a harness defect where no target varied), and both. The middle one is the dangerous one -- a run that never varied its target would have reported rho 0.0 and read as the bar's NO_TARGET_CONTROL outcome. A broken run wearing the costume of a null result.
but_the_SAME_SHAPE_was_present_and_WORSE.the_repos_OWN_convention_already_disagre: Five other independent copies of this same guard -- hiv_esm_likelihood_probe, humsavar_am_vs_esm, kaggle_proteingym_sweep, tem1_forward_cell, protein_effect_facevalidity -- return NaN or None, a value nobody can mistake for a result. This arm was the lone copy returning 0.0, and the newest.
but_the_SAME_SHAPE_was_present_and_WORSE.fixed: raises DegenerateSpearman with a `side` field naming WHICH input is constant. Strictly stronger than NaN, because the bar needs a dead knob told apart from a broken harness.
but_the_SAME_SHAPE_was_present_and_WORSE.verified_two_ways: 6987 non-degenerate cases compared against the pre-fix function with ZERO values moved, including 3987 heavy-tie cases where the ranking branch does the most work; and 13 randomly-generated tie cases genuinely hit the degenerate branch and are now refused, so the guard fires on real data and not only on hand-built fixtures.

preconditions_now_enforced_before_any_sp: CONDITIONING KNOB MOVES THE OUTPUT -- scripts/server1/glm_human_diffusion_server1.py refuses with exit 4 if two different bins on identical input give identical logits. Verified non-vacuous: wired knob max|delta| 0.926238, cond embedding zeroed 0 exactly. The bar's NO_TARGET_CONTROL text demands this check and nothing performed it; --shuffle-labels tests whether the LABEL carries information, never whether it REACHES the logits.
SPEARMAN REFUSES RATHER THAN RETURNING A PLAUSIBLE ZERO -- see above.

BUILT 2026-11-22 (was STILL OWED): scripts/glm_human_activity_oracle.py::assert_oracle_fixture() scores a known input to HAND-DERIVED values and RAISES OraclePreconditionFailed on any mismatch. Called first by both the oracle and the stratified null, and stamped into both artifacts so 'the precondition passed' is distinguishable from 'it never ran'. It catches CHANGED BEHAVIOUR -- a re-indexed k-mer table, a dropped normalisation, an ambiguous base counted instead of skipped, a transposed positional layout -- which is the limit P2 named of its own absence-detecting preflight. Non-vacuity: six perturbations of the feature builder, all refused; the attempt that did NOT fire exposed a blind spot in the fixture (an ACGT-periodic sequence at bins=4 gives a SYMMETRIC matrix, so a base-major/bin-major reshape flip passed), closed by a second asymmetric non-square fixture. LIMIT: it pins the FEATURE pipeline, not the fitted ridge.
RULE_3_PRECONDITIONS_THAT_RAISE.known_limit_carried_from_the_peer: A preflight detects ABSENCE, not a wrong-version dependency that imports and returns plausible numbers. No version pin exists for this arm's scoring path.

RULE_4_CONTROLS_NEED_N_DRAWS_NOT_ONE.peer_finding: P2's random-removal control was a single draw (random.Random(4242)), so every number from it is conditional on that draw -- the same criticism its own governance doc already made of its PERTURBATION control, not applied here. Build it as N draws from the start; cheaper than retracting twice.
RULE_4_CONTROLS_NEED_N_DRAWS_NOT_ONE.this_arm_had_the_identical_defect: --shuffle-labels derived its permutation from `a.seed ^ 0x5EED`, so the no-information arm was ONE draw, and the tier plan scheduled exactly one shuffled point. Every NO_TARGET_CONTROL contrast would have been conditional on that single permutation.
RULE_4_CONTROLS_NEED_N_DRAWS_NOT_ONE.fixed: a --shuffle-seed flag decoupled from --seed, so the arm runs at several permutation draws with the training seed held fixed, which also separates permutation variance from training variance. When it is omitted the run prints that it is a single draw and that the contrast must not be read from it.
RULE_4_CONTROLS_NEED_N_DRAWS_NOT_ONE.note: Deriving the draw from --seed was doubly wrong: it gave one draw AND it moved the permutation, the init and the batch order together, so the two variances could not have been separated even across seeds.

PEER_ITEMS_THAT_DO_NOT_APPLY_HERE.re_patching_is_not_free: P2 withdrew 'annotation-anchored re-patching is FREE' as an equivalence claim, and only the large negative stands (single-nt re-patching catastrophic, |t| 23.65). INAPPLICABLE: this arm never re-patches. It is single-nucleotide throughout, BASES='ACGT' at both training and sampling time, with no generation-time retokenisation. Recorded explicitly rather than skipped, and NOT over-read -- P2's result is about re-patching quality preservation and says nothing about single-nt NATIVE training, which is what this arm does.
PEER_ITEMS_THAT_DO_NOT_APPLY_HERE.prompt_leakage: Already INAPPLICABLE BY CONSTRUCTION per the bar: the generator conditions on a scalar target, not on flanking sequence, so there is no sequence prompt to copy.

honest_limits: This is a protocol, not a measurement. Nothing here has been run against a generator, because no human generator has been trained.

RULE_1's resolution of the bar's ambiguity is an INTERPRETATION of frozen text, taken in the conservative direction and recorded rather than silently applied. A reader who disagrees should know the literal reading of 'the generated set's own seed spread' is the sampling-level one.
The family-wise machinery in RULE_2 is specified but not implemented -- there is no code for it yet, because there are no replicate rows to permute.

RULE_3's third precondition (oracle scores a known fixture) is BUILT as of 2026-11-22 -- see the RULE_3 list. The limit that REPLACES it: the fixture pins the feature pipeline only, so a changed linear-algebra backend that still builds identical features would pass it; that case is covered only by the artifact value pins in tests/test_human_oracle_precondition.py, which are drift pins on recorded numbers rather than an independent recomputation.
P2's corrections were adopted on its own account of them. They were not independently re-derived on its data, which is not in this tree.

FOLD_9_REMEASUREMENT_DISCHARGED.what: the oracle gate and the ceiling were both measured on folds 9+10 pooled, which includes the FINAL_ONLY shard; both are now re-measured on fold 9 ALONE and fold 10 is read by nothing in force
FOLD_9_REMEASUREMENT_DISCHARGED.result: no verdict changed. The shard change moved the K562 ceiling +0.0184 = 0.72 sd of its own sampling spread (not detectable) and every oracle arm by at most 0.0063.
FOLD_9_REMEASUREMENT_DISCHARGED.the_finding_came_from_elsewhere: running the ceiling arm again surfaced a biased subsample inside it: quintiles() returns each stratum sorted by activity ASCENDING and the arm took the first n, i.e. every stratum's LOWEST-activity members, truncating the top quintile's tail. Correcting that moved the ceiling +0.0999 in K562 (3.93 sd) -- five times the shard effect. Direction matters: the ceiling is the DENOMINATOR of every fraction-of-ceiling, so understating it OVERSTATED a generator's share of achievable signal.
FOLD_9_REMEASUREMENT_DISCHARGED.relevance_to_RULE_1: the ceiling now ships with a MEASURED draw spread (sd 0.0254 K562 / 0.0253 HepG2) rather than as a bare point, which is what this protocol's refusal of frozen numeric tolerances requires of the one quantity every fraction is divided by.
